item.title: Trump lashes out at Pope Leo again ahead of Rubio trip to Rome
item.summary: The criticism of the pontiff’s stance on Iran highlighted what Vatican officials have described as an unprecedented low in relations with the United States.

item.title: After defying Trump, a Republican lawmaker hangs on by a thread
item.summary: Republicans in Indiana’s Senate tested voters’ tolerance for defying the president. Most lost in primaries amid a wave of threats, campaign cash and popular backlash.

item.title: The pro-Israel political consensus is collapsing in both parties
item.summary: On the campaign trail and elsewhere, the alliance has gone from a bipartisan consensus to a subject of fierce debate among Republicans and Democrats alike.

item.title: White House correspondents’ dinner suspect indicted on 4 felony charges
item.summary: A grand jury charged Cole Tomas Allen with attempting to assassinate President Donald Trump, assaulting a Secret Service officer with a shotgun and other offenses.

item.title: FBI raids business of powerful Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas
item.summary: The offices of state Sen. L. Louise Lucas, a Democrat, as well as a cannabis dispensary she co-owns were raided. The exact nature and targets of the probe remain unclear.

item.title: Poll finds broad rejection of religion-related messages from Trump, Hegseth
item.summary: Americans rate Pope Leo positively but are deeply critical of the president’s social media post that appeared to depict him as Jesus, the Post-ABC-Ipsos poll found.

item.title: Republicans who crossed Trump lose in Indiana; Ramaswamy advances in Ohio
item.summary: Primaries in Indiana and Ohio reinforced President Donald Trump’s power in the GOP and set the stakes for several top-tier midterm races.

item.title: In a first, FDA authorizes fruit-flavored vapes for adults
item.summary: The move marks a shift after the FDA for years worked aggressively to regulate flavored vapes. The move came after President Donald Trump reportedly pressed the FDA commissioner to authorize the products.

item.title: Vance makes Iowa debut, joining other potential presidential hopefuls
item.summary: The state will play a key role if the vice president decides to run for president in 2028, and other potential GOP candidates have visited in recent months.

item.title: Activist who gave out fliers with Stephen Miller’s address won’t face charges
item.summary: A prosecutor cited “insufficient evidence” of an intent to harass the White House aide by distributing leaflets in his Northern Virginia neighborhood.
